title: A Stationarity-Based Regret Framework for Time-Varying Nonconvex Composite Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.27218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies time-varying nonconvex composite optimization, where decisions are made sequentially and classical value-based regret notions are generally ill-posed. We introduce a stationarity-based performance framework defined through local regret measures built from first-order optimality conditions, and identify minimal structural requirements under which such measures constitute sound performance criteria. This abstraction encompasses canonical optimality measures, including the proximal-gradient residual, and collapses to classical dynamic regret in convex settings. We then focus on the proximal-gradient residual as a concrete and algorithmically meaningful instantiation for general composite problems. In convex problems, we show that the resulting local regret is equivalent to standard dynamic regret. translated_title: 基于平稳性的时变非凸复合优化后悔框架
translated_abstract: 本文研究时变非凸复合优化问题，其中决策是按序贯方式进行的，而经典的基于函数值的后悔概念在此类问题中通常是不适定的。我们引入了一个基于平稳性的性能框架，该框架通过由一阶最优性条件构建的局部后悔度量来定义，并识别出使这些度量构成合理性能准则所需的最小结构性条件。这一抽象框架涵盖了典型的最优性度量（包括近端梯度残差），并在凸设置下退化为经典的动态后悔。随后，我们将近端梯度残差作为一般复合问题的一个具体且具有算法意义的实例加以重点研究。在凸问题中，我们证明所得的局部后悔与标准动态后悔等价。在非凸设置中，我们证明了在没有时间正则性（temporal regularity）的条件下，次线性的基于平稳性的后悔是不可能达到的（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文为时变非凸复合优化提出了基于一阶平稳性（如近端梯度残差）的局部后悔度量框架，证明该度量在凸情形下等价于经典动态后悔，并指出在非凸情形下若缺乏时间正则性则次线性平稳性后悔无法实现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a stationarity-based local regret framework for time-varying nonconvex composite optimization, showing that the proximal-gradient residual regret is equivalent to classical dynamic regret in convex settings, and that sublinear stationarity regret is unattainable in nonconvex settings without temporal regularity.
